David Wright

Preserved Primary Document • wright-d.htm

Dave Wright was born in Rehobeth Hundred, Sussex Co., DE on 25 May, 1846 and he died in Sussex Co. DE on 30 October, 1913. He was the son of Warren Wright and his wife Maria Sockum. Dave married Emily C. Johnson , the daughter of Whittington Johnson & Ann Norwood. She was born near Angola DE, on the site of the present Philips Campground according to her son, Warren T. Wright.
